Cancels the workflow's own orders resting on the book, for each item: the item's order, all of them, or those of a market or an outcome. What they filled before stays. Items with something cancelled go out of main, the others out of missed.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `trading.cancelOrders` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main`, `missed` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cancel (`which`) | text | no | `order` | order: the item's order, as Place order or Order activity put it on the item. all: every order of the workflow resting on the book. market or outcome: those in it. One of `order`, `all`, `market`, `outcome`. |
| Market (`marketId`) | text | no |  | For market: its condition ID. |
| Token (`tokenId`) | text | no |  | For outcome: its token ID. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on with these fields added. Decimals are text, so they stay exact; times are RFC 3339 text.

| Field | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `cancel` | object | What it cancelled, and what not. |
| `cancel.cancelled` | list of objects | The orders cancelled, as they are now: what they filled before is theirs. |
| `cancel.cancelled[].id` | text | The order's ID in the workflow's orders. |
| `cancel.cancelled[].mode` | text, one of `paper`, `live` | paper or live. |
| `cancel.cancelled[].status` | text | canceled, or filled when it filled before it could be. |
| `cancel.cancelled[].shares` | decimal | Shares it filled before. |
| `cancel.notCancelled` | list of objects | The orders not cancelled, and why: matched already, say. |
| `cancel.notCancelled[].id` | text | The order's ID. |
| `cancel.notCancelled[].reason` | text | Why it was not cancelled. |
